name: Nevada

statute.readVia: web.archive.org snapshot of the official NRS chapter 484D page (Rev. 12/9/2024); leg.state.nv.us blocked us via Cloudflare

windshield.strip: material allowed only on the topmost portion: its bottom edge must be at least 29 in. above the undepressed driver's seat (measured 5 in. in front of the bottom of the backrest, seat rearmost and lowest); not red or amber

frontSide.note: nonreflective; total light transmission of film + glass combined at least 35%, tolerance 7%

backSide.note: allowed if outside mirrors on each side give a view at least 200 ft to the rear

rear.note: allowed if outside mirrors on each side give a view at least 200 ft to the rear

tint.dualMirrors: Required (each side, view of at least 200 ft to the rear) for tint behind the driver

medicalExemption.text: Statute lets the DMV Director provide exemptions by regulation (484D.440(6)); exemption regulation not located/read

penalty.text: Not a moving traffic violation for DMV demerit purposes (484D.440(7)); fine amount not stated in this section

tint.lastAmended: Added 1993 (Stats. 1993, p. 2433); substituted in revision for NRS 484.6195
quotes: Has a total light transmission through the combination, if any, of transparent material and safety glazing of not less than 35 percent with a tolerance of 7 percent.

A side window that is to the rear of the driver, or a rear window, if the vehicle has outside mirrors on each side that are located so as to reflect to the driver a view of the highway through each mirror for a distance of not less than 200 feet
The bottom edge of the material is not less than 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat ... (2) The material is not red or amber in color.

Factory material allowed if the vehicle could have been sold new with such material as standard or optional equipment (484D.440(5)); pre-July 1, 1993 film on 1993-or-older vehicles grandfathered (484D.440(4))

helmet.conditions: Driver and passenger of any motorcycle or moped must wear protective headgear plus glasses/goggles/face shield unless a standard windscreen is fitted

handheldPhone.fineText: Civil infraction: $50 first violation in 7 years, $100 second, $250 third+; doubled-type extra penalties in work/school zones (484B.130/135/370); first violation not treated as moving violation

studdedTires.season: Oct 1 - Apr 30 (metal max 3% of contact area; retractable studs engaged only Oct 1 - Apr 30)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)
